Override (gameface-features/overrides.json): the raw scraper shows this as fully 'supported' because Gameface's CSS parser emits no rejection warning for any pointer-events keyword (verified directly against CohtmlApplication.log — zero warnings, across two separate live probe runs of the same engine build), and pointer-events isn't in the small READBACK_FOCUS allowlist that gets accurate JS set+readback testing (probe-runner.spec.ts). A silent parser accept is not evidence the value actually works at runtime — it just means this property's values aren't validated at parse time, so the log-based detection method can't tell 'supported' apart from 'unvalidated'. Evidence here is carried over from the last version (3.1.0.25) where this was correctly detected; revisit once pointer-events gets real readback coverage.
